paragraphs.text: It opens with complaint braided into nearness. Surely past bearing for You, sole world-Lord: Your Great One’s men levelled with other world-folk. Who trail Your feet ever with love: go where they go, certain joys they savor. Where You are husband, death-ender: whence ache? Where Your fortune stands, what care for other joys? By whom through a wink’s joy the All is won: at once all his time with Your bliss is filled.

Then the vision’s catalogue, item by item. Moon: Your bliss-sap drop, fallen earthward. Likewise sun: Your forth-fared spark of world-burning heat. Offering we bear to this third eye of Yours: sole badge of some unworldly greatness. Seen by Him alone, who overjoys in Your vision and the rest. Or by whatever joy of His, somehow: thereby are You seen. Whom You favor, All, who have won Your heart: dragging from Your city, the outside they in-make. Without You, let the all-world be seen gone same-eyed — but this world’s Ruler, You alone: Uneven-eyed. Leave be: without Your might, being itself is not — and whose Thee-blaming talk without You holds not. Stood my mind in You alone, lonely, outer-inner-hindrance-free: what else, All, avails? Others roam, Lord, in the self itself, ill-placed past measure. Others roam, Lord, in the self itself, well-placed past measure. Your love-nectar undrunk, Yourself unseen even, Ruler: by mere Your company alone souls ripen. Your slaves are we, All: as You bear Yourself for three worlds, to-be-borne by You are we too, fully. Seen even in You, high-bliss-nectar, world-self: for touch-sap I hunger past-past, Thine. God — all pains, even the passing-through’s: yoked to Your ghee-named self, grow bearable.

Then paradox, then seal. All-knowing, all-mighty, knowing-made: somehow, Lord, this world’s unreality-show is fit. By You breathed, these strands throb — clod-like even — dancing wind-lifted, as cotton-fluff. If, Lord, no I-pride in strands were: whereby would the world lose its Thou-alone-self-show? Praised, even the great ones gone to dissolving: Your-anger-fire-touch-pure, High-Lord. Your great-light body standing plain: on all sides, Ruler, why in dark range I? Undivided, You alone: my nectar-nature. Yet to mortal ways I am the one seat. Whose speech-jewel is Great-Lord, bow-brand on brow: he alone is mighty. Being, unbeing, You alone. So effortless, by own sap alone, Lord: why is ripening not mine? Shiva’s slave, Shiva-one-self: what joy wins he not? Chief gods themselves I sate with drink, nectar-wines. Heart-navel-between, breathers’ bile-bodied: You eat, great fire, all still, all moving.
